question_text: What is one way Americans can serve their country?

official_answers.text: Work for local, state, or federal government

why_it_matters.text: Serving your country doesn't only mean wearing a uniform. The Founders thought a republic couldn't survive unless ordinary citizens did their part: voting, paying taxes, obeying laws, helping their community. Service is what makes the whole system work. In a self-governing country, the citizens ARE the government — so they have to show up.

fun_fact.text: The Founders thought a republic couldn't survive unless citizens did their part. They called this 'civic virtue.' Service doesn't only mean joining the military — voting, paying taxes, even just obeying the law are all forms of service. They're what makes self-government actually work. A republic needs citizens who care enough to keep it running.
